name: EFW Extreme Monday Night, 12 December 1998
no_appearances_reason: Full character-level minting is deferred except for the Children of Darkness stable and this show's own AsH pre-match vignette (angle, above); every other named participant's bout pairs a minted wrestler against an unminted opponent, so per the shard-shape rule those bouts stay in the page text rather than in matches[].
notes: Posted in 6 parts (msg_ids 8yOHDmHOueMJ, NfY_BLa6dYwJ, LmBjqjnacBMJ, Qu-fYGptZpQJ, FZNd860yD_oJ, usAyCORGSioJ), joined onto one page. Results: Victoria Vixen defeated Casey Collins; Billy Kane upset AsH by Hurricanrana pinfall in 24:47; Kestral (Children of Darkness) retained the EFW Extreme North American Championship against Tommy Grayson after his stable interfered with chairs; the EFW Extreme Television Championship match between champion Razor Ron Jeremy and Despair (Children of Darkness) ended without a finish when the Sinister Seven ran in on both men, setting up a Green Boot Match at Seasons Beatings 98; an advertised Extreme Six Man Championship match did not occur after two of the challengers brawled backstage instead of wrestling, and Death Inc. (the champions) jumped Cold Hearted Killah in the aisle; Krypt and Pariah (Children of Darkness) won a three-way elimination tag over Double Cross (Kyle Combs and Steve Miller) and SEXtreme (Mick Mann and Stupendous Steve), earning a #1 contendership for the EFW World Tag Team Titles; the Privateers (Jacob and Edward Drake) retained the EFW World Tag Team Titles over the Firebyrds (Boston Bruiser and Ringmaster X) in a double-scaffold 'Byrds Nest' match. The episode closes on a hype segment for the wing's own 3rd Seasons Beatings PPV (27 Dec 1998, served separately).

name: EFW Extreme Monday Night, 23 December 1998

matches.stipulation: Winning side's pinfall got Unleaded the singles EFW World Heavyweight Title shot at Seasons Beatings 98; the losing pair went into a #1 contender's match instead.
matches.finish: Champion Glass Joe chair-shotted his own partner Unleaded, then AsH -- asked by Joe to pick which of his own opponents he wanted to face -- chair-shotted his own partner Impaler and dragged Unleaded's arm over Impaler for the pin.

no_appearances_reason: Full character-level minting is deferred beyond the Children of Darkness stable, Glass Joe, Unleaded and Impaler; every other named participant's bout pairs a minted wrestler against an unminted opponent, so per the shard-shape rule those bouts stay in the page text rather than in matches[].
notes: Posted in 5 parts (msg_ids kUVPX30yrE8J, fhbmXM1WcHMJ, BPZ3w46Nz4QJ, x1gEGx3aZ1YJ, aDBi2Z1mgU8J), joined onto one page. Results not otherwise structured above: Neko Daisuke defeated Victoria Vixen; Ringmaster X made Dr. Smart submit; Lil' Cheetah defeated Tigress; Double Cross (Kyle Combs and Steve Miller) defeated Jason Roth and Razor Ron Jeremy in 24:10; Tommy Grayson defeated Despair (Children of Darkness) in a bloody #1 contender's match for the EFW Extreme Television Championship in 19:47; Cold Hearted Killah won a handicap match over Ubas the Suicidal and Hot Bod Steve Sodd; the Privateers (Jacob and Edward Drake) and a mystery partner revealed as Tommy Grayson defeated Kestral and Krypt (Children of Darkness, two men down after Pariah went missing searching for DarqueAngel) when Pariah arrived late and accidentally chair-shotted his own partner Krypt. The matches above set the Seasons Beatings 98 card (27 Dec 1998, served separately): Unleaded vs. Glass Joe for the EFW World Title, and a #1 contender's match between AsH and Impaler.
